name: core.openwop.workflows.lighthouse
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0149 / ADR 0155 follow-on). The five zero-config 'lighthouse' workflows from the ADR 0149 catalog — Lead Triage, Account Brief, Renewal & Churn-Risk Digest, RFP Response, and Post-Meeting Follow-up — authored entirely over node typeIds shipped with this host (feature.crm/kb/analytics + core.ai.chatCompletion + core.chat.approvalGate + core.openwop.integration.*). Each rides real tenant data through the feature node packs, reasons with the LLM node, gates every external send behind a human approval, and delivers a usable artifact. Tenant-specific values are RUN PARAMETERS (never hardcoded) so the expansion stays replay-deterministic. Picking one in the builder instantiates a fully-editable, runnable, assignable workflow.
author: openwop

chains.label: Inbound Lead Triage & Routing
chains.description: Enrich and score an inbound lead, draft a first-touch reply, gate it for review, then send and log it. Real CRM data via feature.crm; every send behind a human approval. ADR 0582 §11 — the send hangs off a `truthy approved` conditioned edge AND the drafted text is routed THROUGH the gate (`draft.content → approve.artifact → send.text`), so a REJECTED review sends nothing. Both halves are load-bearing: `core.chat.approvalGate` returns status:'success' on reject too, and a conditioned edge ALONE is not enough — an unconditional sibling data edge into the send node satisfies `all_success` by itself and would mail the draft anyway.

firstTouchTone.description: Tone for the drafted first-touch reply.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

chains.label: Account Brief & Next-Step Draft
chains.description: Pull a company profile and its deals, synthesize an account brief with recommended next steps and a draft outreach, gate it, then notify the owner. Real CRM data; advisory send behind approval. ADR 0582 §11 — the notification hangs off a `truthy approved` conditioned edge and the brief is routed THROUGH the gate (`brief.content → approve.artifact → notify.message`), so a REJECTED review notifies no one.
